follow-up time: from conception to the child's first birthday
cohort: Women who gave birth in Queensland, Australia between July 1, 2012, and June 30, 2015
finding: Women who gave birth in private hospitals in Australia incurred significantly higher out-of-pocket fees than those who gave birth in public hospitals, despite the country's universal health coverage.
mod_finding: Total out-of-pocket fees were higher for women who had a cesarean birth compared to vaginal birth, regardless of whether they gave birth in a public or private hospital.
